description: devflow guard (refuses writes to real data, touching or reading secrets and reverting uncommitted status and plan edits; asks before release and forced-push commands) and the session-start summary (branch, uncommitted files, CI on HEAD, the plan's next open step). Both do nothing in a project without a devflow config: `.claude/devflow.json` in the repo, or a `devflow-store` pointer in git's common dir naming a store outside the clone.

hooks.command: p="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; g="$p/.git"; if [ -f "$g" ]; then IFS= read -r g 2>/dev/null < "$p/.git"; case "$g" in *[[:cntrl:]]) g="${g%?}" ;; esac; g="${g#gitdir: }"; case "$g" in /*|[A-Za-z]:*) ;; *) g="$p/$g" ;; esac; if [ -f "$g/commondir" ]; then IFS= read -r m 2>/dev/null < "$g/commondir"; case "$m" in *[[:cntrl:]]) m="${m%?}" ;; esac; case "$m" in /*|[A-Za-z]:*) g="$m" ;; *) g="$g/$m" ;; esac; fi; fi; if [ -f "$p/.claude/devflow.json" ] || [ -f "$g/devflow-store" ]; then if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --no-project --quiet python "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/guard.py"; rc=$?; else rc=127; fi; if [ "$rc" -ne 0 ] && [ "$rc" -ne 2 ]; then printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"devflow guard did not run (exit %s) -- not checked"}}' "$rc"; exit 0; fi; exit "$rc"; fi
